reviews.title: Valentine's
reviews.text: After rewatching Super Bowl performances by Bad Bunny, Kendrick Lamar, Michael Jackson, JLO, and Shakira, bet and I went to Asotria, Queens to visit the Museum of Moving Image. I thought the museum was cool, but upon entering, bet couldn’t help but notice the smell of cheese throughout the first exhibit. I had fun because it was interactive. After that, we went to get some food. I saw on Google maps there was a restaurant called Nueva Victoria listed as a Cuban restaurant with 4.9 stars. We got there and find out it wasn’t Cuban and instead, it was an empty Chinese/Spanish restaurant. We decided not to eat there and ended up at a lovely yummy Colombian restaurant. Bet and I ordered the number 8, which had steak, chicharron, arepa, maduros, avocado, white rice, pinto beans, and an egg. Now we're on the train on our way to see Wuthering Heights at 7:15. I hope I like it! OG:  "2026-02-14T23:43:01.514Z"

reviews.title: WFH
reviews.text:
first day of spring. sat in the park and answered emails. i upped my dosage of accutane. took the first pill today and i can already feel the new pimples coming to the surface.           

a few weekends ago i watched Interstellar and Arrival for the first time. I think I like Arrival more.                                on saturday i saw Cat Power live at Webster Hall. rock n roll!! also deleted tiktok. one week without it. i already feel so much better but am experiencing fomo. i had no idea harry styles released a new album. how am i supposed to know how we the people are feeling about it?? after coming up with an opinion of my own i will have to have these conversations in person to see what the temperature of the water is. read an article. subscribe to a magazine. buy an alarm clock and never turn on the alarm.

reviews.title: wuts my vibe
reviews.text: trying to get to 5. haven't had a good cry in a month and i think i'm backed up. im gonna get myself there. drinking cold brew with oat milk creamer to cheer me up. i need to perform efficiently today for i am a working girl. &&&& i need to take myself shopping even though im scared of spending money that i dont have. buying clothes at this point is like paying for my spectrum bill ... its a must! the last time i bought a new item of clothing was probably in the summer. last year i felt blessed from the universe every time i went thrifting. my acne def made me stop shopping. i wanted to avoid my reflection at all costs. now that my acne is gone im ready. nothing in my closet makes me feel good and i waited to see how long that feeling would last and its survived the fall and winter. new shoes new pants new skirt new dress new sweater and a new top. i think thatll b good. ughhhhhhhhhh

reviews.title: realizing things
reviews.text: mum is in town, and it's perfect timing. i can tell april is going to be a month of reflection and direction. today i'm wearing a blouse that i haven't worn in a long time, the same one i wore in a selfie i took a few days after my 25th birthday, right before it felt like things went to shit. during my femcel era, i would compare my current self to that selfie, since it was one of the last moments i felt chill. i was freaking out because i had worked so hard the past year to get to the point where i felt normal again, that when it seemed like i was losing myself, i spiraled. 2025 was the first year where time sort of stood still, not in a bad or good way. my relationship with my scar was healing. i was getting close to being an operable person again. and then all of a sudden, i started losing control. i'd light a candle and shower with the lights off. my heart would race every time i came across a mirror. i would spend my nights going through my camera roll, looking at the months before. today i'm wearing the same top i was wearing in that selfie. my skin has cleared (just super dry), and my bangs are growing out. i'm starting to look like that girl again, but in doing so i realized i've been so focused on getting back there that i forgot to move forward. it's been 7 months now, and physically things were up and down, but mentally i have been in the same state. totally consumed with distractions i use as medicine. none of the clothes that i used to wear give me the same energy they once did. my hair is longer, frizzier. my arms are getting a little bigger. i can't wait till i can get my eyebrows tweezed and thread my mustache.

reviews.title: the worst person in the world
reviews.text: the first time i saw this movie i was 21 on a plane to italy. adrian and i watched it together. i watched the movie again tonight on tubi. i didn't remember much from the first time i watched it, but now i relate to it more than i did before. i think the last time i watched it, i was in the mood for a cute coming of age rom com, and i had gone into it blind. i didn't get what i wanted, so i don't think i retained it very well. i wasn't fully equipped. i'm a sucker for any image of a woman with bangs running freely. my favorite canvas to project onto, just at the time, i couldn't get myself there. now unfortunately i can.

reviews.title: interviews
reviews.text: tapping into all of my online platforms. i literally can't read. how to read something that i don't care about. i guess photos? but all of the photos are starting to look the same. and i am guilty of all of the things. photos are so bad now that i'd rather read. and videos are getting bad 2. i redownloaded tiktok to get some of my camera roll back but the tarot card readers were all online and waiting for me. now i'm cloudy again. no video no photo no reading. ok so sound? itis the one consistent thing. doesn't matter if it's in motion. just need the sound. so recording? singing? i'm at work and bored. if i'm going to be alone i'd rather be alone on a cruise. sitting in a jacuzzi avoiding eye contact with the person who just walked in. eughgghghgh. i'm sitting at my desk and my waistband is way too tight around my gut. a year ago i started applying lotion everyday and the results are in. my hands are so soft.
